verdict.rationale: Bolna documents one official SDK, the Web Call SDK. It connects a browser tab to a voice agent through a single class with six events, so it is narrowly scoped to embedding live web calls rather than building against the platform broadly. The CLI, MCP server and REST API are separate capabilities and earn no credit here; no published OpenAPI spec was found that could stand in for SDK generation. Missing for 10: general-purpose server-side SDKs (e.g. Python/Node) covering agents, calls and batches, SDK reference depth beyond the web-call class, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Web Call SDK connects a browser tab directly to a Bolna voice agent for a live, two-way conversation.
Drop live, spoken conversations with a Bolna voice agent into any web page. One class, six events, no telephony expertise required.
